final: WITH type_counts AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(*) AS match_count FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY o.ordertune), overall AS (SELECT AVG(match_count) AS avg_count FROM type_counts) SELECT AVG(t.match_count) AS avg_kept_count, AVG(t.match_count - a.avg_count) AS avg_excess FROM type_counts AS t JOIN overall AS a ON a.avg_count IS NOT NULL WHERE t.match_count > a.avg_count
